What should your restaurant pay for AI phone answering?

Standard prices before discounts. Choose Maple Voice for answering, hours, FAQs, and call transfer: $150 per month, or $85 per month billed yearly. Choose Maple Pro when callers need to place orders or manage reservations: $350 per month, or $220 per month billed yearly. Confirm your POS and reservation setup before launch.
If you are missing calls during service

Start with the requests your staff miss: hours, menu questions, orders, or reservations. Answering a call and completing an order solve different problems. Voice handles answering and transfers; Pro adds ordering and supported integrations.
Check the cost against your own orders

Divide the monthly plan price by what you keep from an extra order after its variable costs. For example, using the standard monthly rate and $10 per extra order, $350 a month requires 35 extra orders to cover the plan price. This is an illustration, not a forecast; use your own costs and count only orders you would otherwise lose.
Work through the value of phone ordering

The standard yearly rates equal $1020 a year for Voice and $2640 a year for Pro. When comparing quotes, check the plan, billing term, location count, payment charges, and any setup or third-party costs together.

Test your setup before going live

Bring your menu and phone setup. Try an order with a required choice and an item change, inspect what reaches the kitchen, and test a transfer to staff. If you also need reservations, check that workflow separately.
